verdict.rationale: The evidence shows per-key monthly spend caps, service accounts, and MCP server registration. None of it says these can be provisioned programmatically through an admin or management API; they may only be dashboard features. The OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path, and no admin endpoints for creating keys, gateways, or budgets are documented.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can provision gateways, keys, and budgets programmatically through an admin API
